description: Web frontend for a database visualizer application, providing the UI layout and client-side scripting to browse databases, tables, and view data with interactive features.
external_files: CSS styles embedded in the HTML head

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing the database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML for table display based on fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Returns HTML for individual cell content, with expand/collapse for large or object data.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
